invitation.mayHaveJoined: You may have joined the organization.

organizations.description: Choose an organization to see its queue, runners and devices.

setup.title: Set up SandRun
setup.linkOwnSand.title: Link OwnSand
setup.linkOwnSand.detail: Link the OwnSand organization whose devices run your work, with an OwnSand organization API key.
setup.connectWorkSource.title: Connect GitHub or create an agent integration
setup.connectWorkSource.detail: Install the SandRun GitHub App for GitHub Actions jobs, or add a Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex or Devin integration for agent sessions.
setup.connectWorkSource.next: Next step: connect GitHub or create an agent integration.
setup.createRunnerProfile.title: Create a runner profile
setup.createRunnerProfile.detail: A runner profile describes one kind of runner: its workload, guest OS, resources and priority.
setup.createRunnerProfile.next: Next step: create a runner profile.
setup.invalidLink.detail: OwnSand rejected the saved API key. An admin must replace it to resume dispatch.
setup.invalidLink.next: Next step: replace the OwnSand API key.
githubSetup.title: Connect GitHub
githubSetup.description: Link the GitHub organization where you installed the SandRun GitHub App.
githubSetup.missingDetails: The address has no GitHub installation details. Start the installation again from the integrations of your organization.
githubSetup.singleUse: The installation link is single-use. Start the installation again from the integrations of your organization.
githubSetup.organizationMismatch: Choose the SandRun organization where you started the GitHub installation.
githubSetup.notAdmin: Only an owner or admin of a SandRun organization can link a GitHub installation.
members.partial: Some members are not shown yet.
profiles.filter.label: Runner profile
audit.title: Audit events
audit.description: Changes in this organization, newest first. Audit events never contain credentials, commands, output or file contents.
audit.column.subject: Subject
apiKeys.title: Personal API keys
apiKeys.description: A personal API key lets a coding agent or another program use dev sessions as you, for example with {command}. It works only for dev sessions, and only you see your keys.
apiKeys.empty.title: No personal API keys
apiKeys.empty.description: Create a key for a coding agent that uses dev sessions.
apiKeys.createDialog.title: Create a personal API key
apiKeys.createDialog.description: The key authenticates as you, but only on dev session calls.
apiKeys.createDialog.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to {max} characters, for example the agent that uses the key.
apiKeys.createDialog.nameDescription: Helps you recognize the key later.
apiKeys.secretDialog.title: Your new personal API key
apiKeys.secretDialog.label: API key
apiKeys.secretDialog.hint: It works only for dev sessions. Set it as {variable} for the SandRun CLI or {command}.
apiKeys.revokeDialog.title: Revoke {name}?
apiKeys.revokeDialog.description: Programs that use the key stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
devSessions.title: Dev sessions
devSessions.description: A dev session is a sandbox of one user for builds and tests on another guest OS. Run commands and copy files with the SandRun CLI, the SandRun MCP server or the SDKs; the console shows no commands, output or files.
devSessions.empty.title: No dev sessions
devSessions.empty.description: Create a dev session with {command} or the SandRun MCP server, with a dev session runner profile.
devSessions.deleteDialog.title: Delete this dev session?
devSessions.deleteDialog.description: A queued dev session is canceled. A starting or running one ends after SandRun deletes its sandbox; running commands and files in it are lost. This cannot be undone.
runners.title: Runners
runners.description: Each runner is one OwnSand sandbox that serves at most one request. SandRun deletes it when the work ends.
runners.empty.title: No runners match
runners.empty.description: Runners start for waiting requests and for the warm count of each runner profile.
runners.deleteDialog.title: Delete this runner?
runners.deleteDialog.description: SandRun deletes the runner and its OwnSand sandbox. Work that runs in it stops at once. This cannot be undone.
requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Each request is one GitHub Actions job, agent session or dev session. Waiting requests come first, in queue order.
requests.empty.title: No requests match
requests.empty.description: Requests appear when GitHub queues a job with a SandRun label, a vendor asks for an agent session or a member creates a dev session.
requests.cancelDialog.title: Cancel this request?
requests.cancelDialog.description: The request ends with Canceled and never gets a runner. A GitHub job stays queued in GitHub until GitHub cancels it.
overview.title: Overview
overview.description: The queue of every workload kind, the runners and the device pool of the linked OwnSand organization.
overview.live.label: Queue updates
overview.queue.title: Waiting requests
overview.queue.empty.title: No request is waiting
overview.queue.empty.description: New GitHub jobs, agent sessions and dev sessions appear here in queue order.
overview.runners.title: Runners by state
overview.devices.title: Device pool
overview.devices.description: Devices, their limits and the vCPU overcommit are managed in the OwnSand console.
overview.devices.linkLoadFailed: Could not load the OwnSand link.
overview.devices.linkRequired.title: OwnSand link required
overview.devices.linkRequired.missing: An admin must link an OwnSand organization to show its devices.
overview.devices.linkRequired.invalid: An admin must replace the OwnSand API key to show its devices.
overview.devices.empty.title: No devices
overview.devices.empty.description: Link an OwnSand organization with devices, or enroll a device in the OwnSand console.
members.title: Members
members.description: People who can use this SandRun organization. SandRun memberships are separate from OwnSand memberships. Profiles come from your Delino account.
members.removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
members.removeDialog.description: They lose access to this organization. SandRun revokes their personal API keys and ends their dev sessions.
members.leaveDialog.title: Leave this organization?
members.leaveDialog.description: You lose access to this organization. SandRun revokes your personal API keys and ends your dev sessions. An admin can invite you again.
members.invitations.title: Invitations
members.invitations.createDialog.descrip: You get a one-time link that works for 7 days. Send it to the person you invite.
members.invitations.secretDialog.title: Your invitation link
members.invitations.secretDialog.label: Invitation link
settings.title: Settings
settings.devSessionLimit.title: Dev sessions per user
settings.devSessionLimit.description: The most dev sessions that one user can have queued, starting or running at the same time. Leave it empty for no limit. Lowering it ends no existing dev session.
settings.devSessionLimit.label: Limit per user
settings.devSessionLimit.invalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1, or clear the field for no limit.
settings.devSessionLimit.removed: Dev sessions have no per-user limit.
settings.devSessionLimit.saved: The dev session limit is saved.
settings.transfer.title: Transfer ownership
settings.transfer.description: The new owner gets every permission. You become an admin.
settings.delete.title: Delete organization
settings.delete.description: Cancels every queued request, deletes every runner and removes the OwnSand link, the GitHub installations, the agent integrations and every member. The SandRun GitHub App stays installed in GitHub: uninstall it in the settings of each GitHub organization, because SandRun cannot uninstall it.
settings.transferDialog.title: Make {name} the owner?
settings.transferDialog.description: You become an admin. Only the new owner can give ownership back.
settings.deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
settings.deleteDialog.description: Every runner is deleted and every queued request is canceled. Uninstall the SandRun GitHub App in GitHub yourself, because SandRun cannot uninstall it. This cannot be undone.
profiles.form.codexGuestOsUnavailable: SandRun has not verified a guest OS for OpenAI Codex. You cannot save this profile yet.
profiles.form.workspacePath.required: Enter the workspace path. Dev session sync writes into it.
profiles.form.workspacePath.tooLong: Use a workspace path of at most 1,024 UTF-8 bytes.
profiles.form.workspacePath.invalidChara: Use valid Unicode and remove control characters from the workspace path.
profiles.form.workspacePath.windowsAbsol: Enter an absolute Windows path, for example {example}.
profiles.form.workspacePath.absolute: Enter an absolute path, for example {example}.
profiles.form.workspacePath.components: Use a path below the root with no empty, . or .. components and no trailing separator.
profiles.form.workspacePath.windowsChara: Use backslashes as separators and remove {characters} from Windows path components.
profiles.form.workspacePath.windowsTrail: Remove trailing dots and spaces from Windows path components.
profiles.form.workspacePath.windowsDevic: Replace reserved Windows device names such as {examples}.
profiles.form.wholeMilliseconds: Enter a duration in whole milliseconds.
profiles.form.nameInvalid: Use 1 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, for example {example}.
profiles.form.integrationRequired: Select the agent integration of the profile.
profiles.form.guestOsNotVerified: Select a guest OS that SandRun has verified for OpenAI Codex.
profiles.form.guestOsUnsupported: The vendor of this integration does not run on this guest OS.
profiles.form.templateRequired: Enter the ID of an OwnSand template of this guest OS.
profiles.form.vcpuRange: Enter a whole number of vCPUs from 1 to {max}.
profiles.form.memoryRange: Enter a whole number of MiB from 1 to {max}.
profiles.form.diskRequired: Enter the disk size in GiB.
profiles.form.diskRange: Enter a whole number of GiB from 1 to {max}.
profiles.form.idleTtlRequired: Enter an idle TTL greater than zero.
profiles.form.maxTtlRequired: Enter a maximum TTL greater than zero.
profiles.form.maxTtlTooLong: The maximum TTL is at most 7 days (168 hours).
profiles.form.idleTtlTooLong: The idle TTL must not be longer than the maximum TTL.
profiles.form.maxQueueWaitRequired: Enter a maximum queue wait greater than zero.
profiles.form.maxQueueWaitOpenAi: OpenAI waits at most 5 minutes for an executor.
profiles.form.maxQueueWaitTooLong: The maximum queue wait is at most 24 hours (1440 minutes).
profiles.form.warmCountRange: Enter a warm count from 0 to {max}.
profiles.title: Runner profiles
profiles.description: A runner profile describes one kind of runner. GitHub jobs select a profile with its {label} label; agent sessions use the profile of their integration; dev sessions name a profile.
profiles.empty.title: No runner profiles
profiles.empty.admin: Create a runner profile to start runners for your work.
profiles.empty.member: Ask an admin to create a runner profile.
profiles.deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
profiles.deleteDialog.description: Its queued requests end with Canceled, and its warm runners and runners that wait for work are deleted. Busy runners finish their work. This cannot be undone.
profiles.dialog.createDescription: The workload kind and the agent integration cannot change later.
profiles.dialog.editDescription: Changes apply to runners that start after the change.
profiles.dialog.name: Name
profiles.dialog.nameDescription: Lowercase kebab-case. A GitHub job profile gets the runs-on label {label}.
profiles.dialog.savedIntegrationMissing: You cannot save this profile because its agent integration is missing.
profiles.dialog.workspacePathDescription: Required for dev sessions: an absolute guest path. Sync writes into it, and commands start in it.
profiles.dialog.sourceBaseImage: OwnSand base image of the guest OS
profiles.dialog.warmCountDescription: Running sandboxes that wait for a request.
integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: SandRun runs work on the devices of the linked OwnSand organization. GitHub installations and agent integrations bring the work.
integrations.ownSand.title: OwnSand link
integrations.ownSand.empty.title: OwnSand is not linked
integrations.ownSand.empty.description: First step: link the OwnSand organization whose devices run your work, with an organization API key from the OwnSand console.
integrations.ownSand.empty.member: Ask an admin to link OwnSand.
integrations.ownSand.manageDevices: Manage devices in the OwnSand console
integrations.ownSand.dialog.description: SandRun stores the key encrypted and never shows it again. Create an organization API key in the OwnSand console.
integrations.ownSand.dialog.stale: The OwnSand link changed. Close this dialog and start again from Integrations.
integrations.ownSand.removeDialog.title: Remove the OwnSand link?
integrations.ownSand.removeDialog.descri: SandRun stops dispatch, ends every queued request with Canceled, deletes every runner of this organization and then deletes the stored API key.
integrations.github.description: SandRun registers organization-level runners for GitHub Actions jobs whose {label} label names a runner profile. Install the SandRun GitHub App on a GitHub organization; GitHub then returns to this console.
integrations.github.empty.title: No GitHub organization is connected
integrations.github.empty.admin: Connect GitHub to run GitHub Actions jobs, or create an agent integration below.
integrations.github.empty.member: Ask an admin to connect GitHub.
integrations.github.unlinkDialog.title: Unlink {name}?
integrations.github.unlinkDialog.descrip: SandRun cancels the queued requests of this installation and deletes its waiting runners. The GitHub App stays installed in GitHub until you uninstall it there.
integrations.github.groupDialog.title: Change the runner group
integrations.github.groupDialog.descript: GitHub's runner group settings control which repositories can use the SandRun runners.
integrations.github.groupDialog.label: Runner group
integrations.agent.credential.serviceAcc: Enter the service account API key.
integrations.agent.cursorPoolRequired: Enter the Cursor self-hosted pool name.
integrations.agent.title: Agent integrations
integrations.agent.description: An agent integration holds the account or pool of one coding-agent vendor. Agent session runner profiles name one integration.
integrations.agent.empty.title: No agent integrations
integrations.agent.empty.admin: Create an integration for Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex or Devin to run their sessions, or connect GitHub above.
integrations.agent.empty.member: Ask an admin to create an agent integration.
integrations.agent.webhookUrl: Webhook URL to register in the OpenAI project: {value}
integrations.agent.deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
integrations.agent.deleteDialog.descript: SandRun deletes the stored credentials. An integration that a runner profile names cannot be deleted; delete the profile first.
integrations.agent.dialog.createDescript: SandRun stores the credentials encrypted and never shows them again.
integrations.agent.dialog.editDescriptio: Leave a credential empty to keep the stored value. A new value replaces it; SandRun never shows it again.
integrations.agent.dialog.nameInvalid: Enter a name of 1 to {max} characters.
integrations.agent.dialog.replaceHint: {state}. Enter a new value to replace it.
